description: This file defines the internal sealed class 'MigrationContext' used for managing serialization and deserialization of data, including byte buffers and key-value indices, within the Orleans runtime. It implements multiple interfaces for context management, buffer writing, and enumeration, and includes nested classes for enumeration and serialization hooks.

classes.name: MigrationContext
classes.description: An internal sealed class for managing serialization state, including byte buffers and key indices, with support for adding, retrieving, and enumerating stored data.

classes.name: MigrationContext.Enumerator
classes.description: A private nested class implementing IEnumerator<string> for iterating over the keys in the MigrationContext.

classes.name: MigrationContext.SerializationHooks
classes.description: A nested class providing hooks for deserialization, specifically to set the session pool during deserialization.

methods.name: AddBytes
methods.description: Adds a byte array to the buffer under a specified key.

methods.name: AddBytes<T>
methods.description: Adds data written by a provided writer action to the buffer under a specified key.

methods.name: TryAddValue<T>
methods.description: Attempts to serialize a value of type T into the buffer under a specified key, using the codec provider.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Resets the buffer and disposes of resources.

methods.name: TryGetBytes
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the byte sequence associated with a key.

methods.name: TryGetValue<T>
methods.description: Attempts to deserialize a value of type T associated with a key.
